changes: Retain a valid complete token_limit response as a bounded observation and continue after response validation and watchdog closure.

amendment_disclosure.selection_basis: Frozen original task order and recorded not_started status; never answer content, labels, scores or desired outcome.

preservation_reference.future_acquisition_rule: Select exact artifact or preserved original bytes by ID, size and digest before execution; no latest, replacement, or silent fallback.

fixed_stimulus_and_subject.system_message: You are a helpful AI assistant named SmolLM, trained by Hugging Face

original_runtime_archive.reconstruction_method: concatenate unchanged fragment bytes in ascending part_index order

fixed_stimulus_and_subject.future_requirement: Retain exact task/context/instruction bytes, tokenizer/model/dependency bytes, effective generation configuration, per-task isolated context, and stated platform contract; record actual new source, run and image independently.

selection.rule: Original TASK_ORDER.json.task_ids[1:], exactly matching the historical terminal not_started suffix.
selection.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=comma/colon without whitespace; allow_nan=false; exactly one trailing LF.
selection.task_jsonl_line_hash_rule: Hash the exact original UTF-8 physical line including its single LF terminator; line number is one-based in TASKS_DRAFT.jsonl.

continue_only_after: Complete bounded response frame and exact task/subject/runtime/input bindings validated.
Declared stop reason agrees with token IDs; each token ID is within the pinned model vocabulary bound.
Response arrived within the original per-call generation deadline.
Per-call watchdog closure successfully observed before starting the next occurrence.
proposed_protocol.failure_disposition: Preserve all attempts and failure evidence; leave the continuation incomplete and do not start further occurrences.

checks: Verify selected original outer artifact bytes and every nested receipt, archive, inventory and selected source binding.
Reconstruct the exact historical input from original instructions, task record and pinned context ranges.
Validate subject, prelaunch, intent, ready, response, runtime, effective generation, ordered timing and per-call watchdog closure.
Reconstruct retained control-plane, runtime transport, input/install and worker-sandbox records under their original source-bound rules; inventory hashes alone are insufficient.
Verify exactly one historical response quartet and the complete untouched 203-task not_started suffix.
Reconstruct and re-tokenize all 204 original prompt rows with the pinned tokenizer/dependency bytes and compare the exact historical input IDs, without instantiating a causal-language model.
Decode retained new-token IDs with skip_special_tokens=true and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=false; compare text, Base64 and UTF-8 member bytes.
Produce a new source/runtime-bound zero-generation receipt that admits only the historical bounded observation and preserves the original incomplete session and unverified cleanup.
required_historical_verification.on_failure: Block complete composite admission; no regeneration, substitution, silent omission or 203-row measurement is authorized.

checks: Use the final reviewed versioned implementation and fresh zero-generation preflight with independently compared exact source/input/runtime/image/map bindings.
Reacquire the selected preflight evidence and perform its comparison in the current trusted controller, followed immediately by in-process admission; a saved approval is not a permission input.
Bind the separately authorized new request and historical observation receipt before starting any of the 203 calls.
Verify every planned new occurrence once in original order, exact response bindings, deadlines, intent records and watchdog closure.
Require complete session marker, stdout EOF, worker exit zero, observed service cleanup and private-tree cleanup.
Independently verify all new prompt and output token/text relations without new generation.
Verify exact complete evidence inventory, bounded publication and selected artifact readback.

composite_admission.projection_rule: After independent composite admission, project the exact 204 response texts in original order to the unchanged archived-input format, with every row mapped to original response bytes and both source identities preserved by the selected manifest.

future_execution_binding.rule: Future selected identities belong to separately reviewed execution requests and receipts; do not fill or reinterpret this frozen proposal as a dispatch request.
